title: Controlled production SEO rollout prepared; execution awaits approval
summary: Backup checksum and all 1,114 production schema blocks match. Fresh read-only preflight and integrity checks passed. Prepared separate migration/deployment gates and locally tested bounded recovery. No production migration or deployment executed.

changes.detail: Added a read-only schema/backup/preflight runner and current production evidence; original backup and earlier reports preserved.
Prepared bounded recovery SQL and read-only before/after integrity checks.

Documented controlled migration approval, stopping conditions, canary/post-migration gates and separate Next.js release/environment/rollback requirements, respecting the decision not to create hosted staging.

validation.name: Backup and schema
validation.detail: 1,685,487-byte archive, 1,233 entries, original SHA-256 matches. All 1,114 named production schema blocks match backup.

validation.name: Read-only production preflight
validation.detail: Verified TLS, 17.6 primary, owner privileges and expected role properties; no SEO collisions or ledger entry. Counts 34 products, 4 categories, 6 orders and 8 Auth users; clean catalogue integrity.

validation.name: Prepared integrity SQL
validation.detail: Executed read-only in production; no long transactions over 60 seconds or lock-waiting sessions observed at check time.

validation.name: Bounded recovery rehearsal
validation.detail: Local-only transaction disabled both triggers and revoked service RPC; rollback restored original state. Isolated cluster stopped.

validation.name: Production SQL/API/persistence acceptance
validation.detail: Requires approved migration; any production canary writes require separate explicit approval. No hosted integration success claimed.

validation.name: Next.js deployment readiness
validation.detail: Exact release artifact, hosted Production environment and prior deployment rollback target are not verified. Dirty workspace not authorized for bulk deployment; historical build evidence is not a fresh release certification.
